reviews.text: We had a good experience here in an emergency situation. Nova was well taken care of by skilled and caring staff. We felt confident that she was in good hands. She received good treatment, and fortunately made a full recovery. We are very grateful for the help and highly recommend the animal hospital. 🫶🏼

Hi,
It was unfortunate to see that you had such an experience with our visit. We would like you to send us an email to oslo@evidensia.no and explain what happened, so that we can look into the matter and have the opportunity to improve ourselves.
Kind regards,
Evidensia Oslo Veterinary Hospital

Good price. Recommended 😄

I called and was in tears because I know most places dont take faktura and this was a very prestigious place that costed a decent amount of money, so I was already under the impression that I couldn't probably afford this place if they didn't take faktura.. and many veterinarians in norway dont do faktura. That type of thing is in my opinion.. really lame not everybody has a large sum of money just ready always at all times.... but this place was so incredibly amazing... I called and asked about faktura they said they do faktura and I was sitting there just having a really hard time and a horrible day.. feeling just like sh*t and this woman was so nice to me over the phone, being understanding and professional at the same time.

I go to the appointment and I feel like I'm walking into volvat but for dogs, this place is incredibly clean everyone that works there is INSANELY nice and loves their job and loves dogs... I can't say the same for EMPET I had a horrible expeterience with them and got thrown off from the "top" clinics but this was different.. it was so  nice..

Not only did my dog get the proper care he needed but he also made so many friends along the way with the staff and the whole place just feels so wholesome... thank you everybody working there you made not only my day but made my next month or more. I will never forget the experience I had.. the safety, the professionalism, the pure love and empathy and passion.

And if this wasn't already enough ... one of the staff said "oh by the way this is for you, the woman you spoke to on the phone thought you were so nice and wanted you to have this" and she hands me a bag full of dog things, practical things like treats, bandages, gauze, toothpaste, many many things this bag was completely full to the rim with dog stuff.. these are expensive things...  and she did it out of the goodness of her heart hearing i was having a hard time, so if you are reading this, please know you have no idea how much you did for me with that gesture alone genuinely cured so much of my depression and self esteem. Thank you so much.... and thank you all for being amazing and passionate about your job. I will never go to another vet other than you guys.

And also I wanted to say that I did not pay nearly as much as I thought I would its actually insane... I only paid 1000 for the appointment and I easily would have paid multiple thousands more for the care I got..
Very good veterinarians!
Good eye specialist. But not very nice people in the recession

My dog ​​has undergone major surgery, intensive treatment and several check-ups this summer. Throughout the entire period, I have felt well cared for and confident that my dog ​​has received the best treatment.
I have had a very good impression of the entire team, from the reception and the animal caretakers to the assistants and veterinarians. Everyone has been welcoming, professional and caring, and communication has been good throughout the entire treatment process.
I greatly appreciate the security and care you have shown, and am very grateful for the good follow-up we have received ❤️

Hi Thanasis!
Thank you so much for taking the time to give us this positive feedback
Best regards,
Evidensia Oslo Veterinary Hospital

Great service, but the payment solution was NOT good. Customers MUST have funds in their account to pay the bill. Swea is a very bad solution because single/disabled people cannot get loans from them.
Their treatment led to the dog's death. First money, then regulations. The result came last. Not even a hint of sympathy. Strongly not recommended.

Our 14-year-old Chihuahua Ruby became seriously ill while we were travelling in Norway. The team at Evidensia received us quickly, carried out the necessary examinations and explained the findings and options clearly and honestly.

Although the outcome was heartbreaking, we never felt pressured into additional procedures. The veterinarians treated both Ruby and us with kindness, respect and compassion throughout the entire process.

What meant especially much to us was the care shown even after Ruby passed away. When we returned to collect her, a veterinarian personally verified her identity using her microchip and made sure everything was correct before she was released to us. In such an emotional moment, that attention to detail provided enormous comfort.

Thank you for helping us make the most difficult decision a pet owner can face, and for treating our little girl with dignity and respect.

Sandra & Oscar, The Netherlands

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS HERE!!!

We took our cat there 3 times in the course of 3 weeks. The first times they sent the cat home without exams and told us to come back if it got worse. The second time the cat was peeing blood  they gave her pain killers and a anti-inflamatory and told us to come back in 3 days. The third day they decided to take her in for scan, but since it was past 2 pm the exams would need to be done the next day. The overnight and the scan costed 30 thousand nok. The next day the exam was done at 3 pm when they told us her kidneys were gone and she needed to be sacrificed or go through a 100 thousand nok surgery to remove a kidney with little chance of success. Nobody understand why they didn't check her kidneys the first time she was peeing blood. Seems like they just were after the money of the surgery of a dying cat and desperate owners. My cat died in that place due to negligence. Traumatizing experience.

Hi, Ida!
Thank you very much for this nice review. Have a nice day!
Kind regards,
Evidensia Oslo Veterinary Hospital

Absolutely terrible experience 🥹. I had resuscitated our dog, cardiac arrest…. Came in on the night of 14/4-26 at 00:05 .. the dog was barely breathing, what do they do when we come in…. Need full contact info. As well as payment info????? The dog is lying in our arms and is dying🥹♥️. Then they take the dog without saying a word, take an x-ray? I tell them the dog is going to die, needs an injection. Are they gone? We are left alone in an office…… had to walk down the hall and shout for help, the dog dies before the last injection! Over 11,000kr to euthanize the dog?!!

They were available to help during a cat emergency, which we appreciated. However, when we asked whether our cat could stay at the clinic for two nights and be picked up afterward, we were quoted approximately 25,000 NOK for the hospitalization alone. Due to this cost, we decided not to proceed with treatment there.

We found this quote unreasonable. We recommend that pet owners ask for a detailed estimate before using any of their services, to not incur into last-minute surprises.

Best clinic in Oslo. Our cat with kidney failure received all the necessary treatment and examinations. Unfortunately we had to euthanize him in the end and he got a perfect last farewell in one of the quiet zones. The staff was very good at keeping us updated the whole way, helpful with all the details about the visits and Jorun really took good care of us in the last hour. We are very grateful and will only use Evidensia in the future.

We had an emergency situation with a dog that had a severe seizure at night. We called Evidensia first, because we considered them the best. When the most severe seizure subsided, but she was still in a persistent seizure (foaming from the mouth and shaking her head/jaw), we were told to go for a walk to try to "snap her out of it". This did not work. When we called again, we were told to sit quietly with her and wait until the clinic opened at 8 am. Our gut feeling said this was serious, so we called another animal hospital who asked us to come immediately. They emphasized that the situation was critical and time-dependent. She was hospitalized for almost two days. Our advice: If you are not heard – trust your gut and call someone else.

Expensive and bad. More stress than help for both people and animals.
I have been to Evidensia with both of my cats and each time I am disappointed by the unprofessional help and bad attitude towards people and animals.
Last time they had to prick an otherwise very calm cat that has never had any problems taking a blood sample, 5 times before they finally succeeded in taking a blood sample. An hour later it turned out that they did not take enough blood, so we had to come back.
No meaningful feedback on the test results. The vet does not look at the dynamics, i.e. the changes in the tests from time to time, only looks at the last one.
The time my cat had to get medication that is only available at wholesale pharmacies and only after approval from the Norwegian Food Safety Authority, the vet forgot to update the application to the Norwegian Food Safety Authority, so I had a toll trip to Vestby that takes me 1.5 hours one way.
My other cats are losing fur. This process has been going on for a long time, but Evidensia has zero interest in finding the cause. They take a blood test, send back the results and no more suggestions on what to do next.
No one at Evidensia takes responsibility for the process from start to finish. I have to push and push all the time to reach the goal.
Evidensia "inherited" me as a customer from the fantastic Dyrenes venn which they unfortunately had acquired. Will never go there again. A veterinary clinic with this bad attitude should not be on the market at all.

We are left with a very bad experience after treatment at Evidensia. Our cat became acutely ill, and despite repeated visits we experienced a lack of comprehensive assessment.

We are particularly concerned about how quickly it was concluded that a serious condition led to euthanasia. At the same time, extensive sedation was used on several occasions, which we now question.

The experience in a very vulnerable situation was also characterized by little empathy from some of the staff, which made an already difficult period even more difficult.

Overall, this is experienced as a combination of high costs, lack of communication and inadequate care for both animals and owners.

If you want your dog to die and be mistreated this is the place. They only care about profit without considering the dog's health. Here you have to play veterinarian and ask for tests and samples yourself to find out what's wrong with your dog. DO NOT go here.

Hi, Sonja
Thank you for your feedback. We always aim to provide the best possible treatment and care, and would be happy to receive more information at oslo@evidensia.no about what we could have done differently to make your experience with us better if you would like to contact us.
Kind regards,
Evidensia Oslo Veterinary Hospital

If I had the opportunity to give you 0 stars, you would have. Unfortunately, Google accepts 1 star.

If you want your animal to die without being well cared for, Evidensia Oslo Animal Hospital is the place. Here they only think about money. They receive sick sums in acute cases where they do nothing but watch your animal die with minimal measures.

If you have a challenging breed or a dog that can be aggressive, this is not the place for you. They do what is minimal as they only think about their own safety. In the medical record I received it says "cannot be put on a meter, observe visually" absolutely sick. That you should not be able to observe with the necessary equipment in an intensive care unit where you receive high sums is disturbing. When I asked, I was told that there is poor staffing.

As an animal owner, you also want updates about your animal, at Evidensia you can forget about this as they get irritated if you call in to ask about updates/status. The message you receive on the phone and what you see when you meet your animal in reality do not match. I was not informed that my animal was critically ill and could die at their facility or at home before I showed up at the clinic myself. I was also informed that he was breathing just as poorly in the oxygen cage as without. I therefore chose to take my dog ​​home and unfortunately he died after only 30 minutes. This also says a little about the treatment that was given. My dog ​​would not have survived at Evidensia with the treatment they gave him as it was minimal and poor! Here they were only looking for money to keep him longer (this was of course their recommendation).

The most worrying value at Evidensia Animal Hospital is patient safety in records and follow-up. Doctors at the hospital work overtime so that patients do not lose their safety in follow-up if you are critical. Your animal does not get this at Evidensia Animal Hospital, which you should actually get considering the sick sums they earn on animals. Poor record keeping and poor transfer of information between veterinarians.

Zero empathy for pet owners and animals.

I must say I am very disappointed about a clinic that appears to be the best and most modern but, in reality, has poor treatment, poor staffing and unsafe veterinarians (does not apply to the eye department).

If you choose to comment on this feedback, it is good that you do not post your standard response that you give to everyone here with bad reviews. "we can not recognize ourselves in this" "we are not heartless" or ask me to send an inquiry to your email and tell you what has happened. My dog ​​died, that is what has happened.

I am not finished here, you took my best friend from me. You do not deserve a single penny. My strong opinions will go to everyone who has animals where I want to inform each individual that everyone must strongly distance themselves from Evidensia Oslo Animal Hospital

I was happy and gave 5 stars based on the past experiences. I'm updating the rating today... Recently I visited the hospital at the new location due to "emergency". Found out the vet wrote Paracetamol (regular painkliler) in the prescription and charged the prescription fee. As a loyal client for the past years, I feel deeply disappointed by this practice.

Saved the life of my now 11 year old cat 4 years ago. Direct settlement with insurance. Pus was hospitalized for two days and then had checkups. Pus was allowed to stay in the office away from the waiting room when I had to buy supplies at the pharmacy. This is a good place with empathy and great animal caretakers and veterinarians.

Pus has been as healthy as a fish since he almost died that time. All credit to Evidensia for giving Pus a long life ❤️

Vet was great, communication over pricing is very poor.  I was told to come in for a followup that lasted less than ten minutes and was charged 2600NOK.  I would not have come in if I knew I would be charged so much.

We were referred from Nordstrand Animal Clinic with our Welsh Springer Spaniel puppy, our princess Stella Louise, who was only 9 months old, and who ended her short but good life at Evidensia Animal Hospital on March 9th.
We were very well received, and received the very best treatment, information and care from those who treated her and us
Thank you
Sincerely PaulAnita

There´s no price that can buy that. We will see you in 2 weeks, keep up the amazing work!

I was at the clinic on a Saturday evening in an emergency situation with my cat, who was unable to go to the bathroom. I was welcomed quite quickly, which I really appreciated. The staff were very understanding and took my opinions and wishes into account. When I asked what was best to do, I received good and clear advice, while also listening to what I wanted and what my expectations were.

My cat was taken in for examination, tests were taken, and I got the results after about 20 minutes. Then everything was clear. I was informed the whole way, and I actually felt better cared for than I often do in a hospital for people. That's exactly how everyone should be treated - the way my cat was.

Thank you very much for the fantastic follow-up, and an extra big thank you to veterinarian Edel. This was a very good experience. Of course, I hope I don't have to come back, but if it should be necessary, I will definitely come here again.

Professional work they should have, but as an animal owner without insurance and knowledge, and in a moment where everything feels so helpless, I thought that charging so much for a relatively simple repair & treatment was damn poorly done. On round two of following up on my cat's health problems, I was recommended to contact Lisa Klinikken, who did exactly what Evidensia did, and now further help, they do this for free for an owner who does not have the best financial conditions. Last time I HAD to pay a large sum, just to help my animal, and it caused problems for me privately. Such is life, but I expressed this to Evidensia, and the least they could have done was refer me to, for example, Lisa Klinikken, and their fantastic work for animals and animal owners. I will support Lisa Klinikken for all time to come, and I am writing this so that other animal owners will know about it. Helping animals should not be a business about money, shame on you.

Hello,

I would like to give an honest review of our visit to the specialist department of internal medicine. We came there to get a thorough examination and support in a difficult situation, but unfortunately the experience did not meet expectations.

We experienced little empathy from the professional (veterinarian specializing in internal medicine) we met, and the tone was at times condescending and unwelcoming. In addition, we experienced that the veterinarian in internal medicine lacked knowledge and poor ability and willingness to cooperate with us as owners. Our input, concerns and questions were not taken seriously, and the dialogue felt one-sided and not very inclusive.

This lack of cooperation and communication meant that we did not feel confident in the assessments that were made. We therefore chose to visit another veterinary clinic for further examination – and there we finally received the help, information and follow-up we needed.

When you bring a sick animal and are in a vulnerable situation, empathy, cooperation and clear communication mean a lot. In this case, we did not feel taken care of, neither professionally nor personally, which made an already demanding situation even more difficult.

We chose you precisely because you claim to be specialists with high competence, but our experience did not match this.

Based on our experience, I would not recommend Evidensia for dogs with a complex medical history. Despite the fact that Evidensia is one of the most expensive animal hospitals we have spent money on, the treatment and follow-up unfortunately did not meet expectations. We experienced that the cooperation, communication and professional approach were not adapted to an animal with a complex disease picture. For owners who are in similar situations, I would rather recommend NMBU, Empet Skedsmo/Nydalen or Anicura, where we have experienced a more thorough, empathetic and collaborative follow-up.

Tried to hand in my cat and was told they didn't take an invoice with a condescending rude tone. Thought animal welfare was important but no wonder if people can't get an invoice that people don't hand in their animals in an emergency situation. Money clearly weighs more than a living creature. If my cat dies it's thanks to you.

Do you have a sick bird? DON'T TAKE IT THERE
My beloved cockatiel died after weeks of mistreatment, suffering and a total lack of professional assessment.

She had an infection, but was used as a guinea pig. First she was given 4-8 antibiotic injections without effect. Then she was put on a ten-day course of antibiotics – still without improvement. Yet not a single test** was ever taken to find the cause. I said several times that she was not getting better, but was just told to continue with the same treatment.

After two weeks, my other cockatiel also became infected, and he was given the exact same treatment. Both birds suffered for seven weeks, with forced medication, stress and pain. No one took responsibility, no one asked questions.

Finally, I went to another vet (Evidensia), who took tests immediately. Unfortunately, it was too late. My beloved Kiwi died shortly after. And as a final slap in the face, I had to pay for the euthanasia of the bird you were unable to save.

I feel physically sick just walking past the clinic. You charged a lot of money for a treatment that should never have been given. If you had done your job and tested from the start, Kiwi would be alive today.

This was not an accident – ​​it was gross negligence. I do not want an apology from you. What you have done cannot be undone by words. I am writing this so that no one else will have to experience the same pain, helplessness and injustice.
Nice, talented people
Always a good experience coming here with our four-legged friend.

DO NOT GO HERE. I came to Evidensia Ensjø for the first time when I didn't have my own dog yet (I was looking after a dog for a friend from Sweden), and ended up having to pay over 20,000 kroner for the euthanasia of this dog that I was looking after because they thought I had no other choice. In retrospect, when I now have my own dogs and know what things cost, I don't understand how they could charge 20k for this. My friend in Sweden was of course also shocked and didn't have time to come to Norway because they were simply in such a hurry with the decision. The dog was an 11-year-old Pomeranian and personally I can't say anything about whether he could have been saved or not, but you certainly wouldn't think that euthanasia cost 20k. When I have spoken to other veterinary clinics, they are shocked by the bill and the epicrisis I show them, and they believe I was scammed by Evidensia who: 1. Overpaid me by a huge amount, 2. Did not provide proper guidance and information, 3. Scare me out of my mind to get the best possible payment (this is what other veterinarians believe was done on purpose, and is therefore gross fraud), and 4. Maybe could have saved the dog.
At this point, I had no experience with veterinary clinics yet, and I trusted Evidensia because I primarily expected them to tell me the truth, and that they wanted me and the dog well. I have realized in retrospect that they absolutely did not — but that they were only after money.
We have now received advice and recommendations from other veterinary clinics to take the case further to get a full refund and not least to prevent others from experiencing the same thing.
DO NOT GO HERE.
Dog admitted, very good follow-up, professional and friendly staff.

Frigg had surgery today for a cruciate ligament injury at Evidensia Oslo Veterinary Hospital. ♥️

The biggest thanks go to our surgeon, Thomas Sissner. What a fantastic man and professional! 🙏 Before the surgery, he took the time to spend a full hour talking, reviewing X-rays and explaining what was going to happen. When we picked her up, he did the same.

From the first moment we met him, we have felt support, security and care. He did not meet Frigg just as a patient, but as the family member she is. It touches me deeply.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of both Frigg and us! ♥️🐾
Spends a lot of time on something that could have been said in 5 minutes. Signs a binding agreement about the price and comes with a final invoice of several thousand kroner more.

We felt that they cared for our beloved dog and did what they could. Unfortunately, we had to euthanize her, but our experience is that they examined her carefully and did what they could to help. We were present at the euthanasia, and it was done humanely and quickly, which was good for our dog, although terribly sad for us. They offered to call us the next day in case we had any questions. They also kept us updated. It was quite expensive, but you do everything for your four-legged friends.
A bit expensive, but good vets/surgeons 👍🏾 …

Hi, Eugen!
Thank you so much for your great review! We really appreciate you choosing us and look forward to taking good care of your pet in the future 🐾
Sincerely,
Evidensia Oslo Veterinary Hospital

Do not take your animals here. My daughter first took one of our cats here and they did expensive tests and said the cat had grass in its nose. The cat had a common cold, which anyone who was not hysterical could see, but they did heart tests and blood tests. I thought maybe my daughter had scared them, but I think it was expensive and strange.

When our dog got bloat I asked for an overview of the cost of surgery or euthanasia, and got what I thought was real. Afterwards they sent an invoice for expenses that were never mentioned. Steer clear! You do not want your street here.

I had to take my sweet dog to this clinic out of normal working hours because I felt he was not feeling well. My first contact was with the Emilie H.N at the reception showing empathy and support to us. Then specialist Silje Lindrup Robertsen examined my dog completely and made sure he was doing well. I had to pay over NOK 3000 for the appointment, but they had already informed me about it on phone when I first contacted them.

Hi, Tom-Erik!

Came in at night with a Pomeranian who was whining because of pain. The vet was good and helped quickly with treatment. Very good to know that no matter what time of day we can get help for our animals. 1000 thanks

I was there yesterday with my dog, Loki. I was encouraged by my regular vet, Anicura Ekeberg, to go there. They welcomed me warmly, very nice and not least they took incredibly good care of him. I called in the evening and in the morning to hear how it was going and got a lot of compliments on how Loki was. I was very worried about what could happen, but then he was able to walk a little with his back leg when he came out. Got good recommendations from physio and follow-up.
I am infinitely happy for you who work there and Anicura. For me you show a lot of care and not least do your very best for the animals.

It is a big job to fill, as it is not easy. Extremely grateful to you.

I will come back to say hello. Important that I go back to the place where my dog ​​was and is safe and not least a place where I know his heroes work.
Thanks again
Professional treatment by pleasant and welcoming staff 😊 …
Thank you very much, Lena. Good luck, and see you in Spain.

Passionate about finding the cause, and curing it.
Fixes the incredible simply and easily, miracles take a little more time😁 …

Our puppy Platon had a fracture in his paw after an accident. I just have to write that the way we have been received by Ida is impeccable. Calm, understanding, warm and kind-hearted lady who sees her patients. The fact that my husband and I can go to Evedensia Ensjø to meet Ida together or separately, knowing that she sees us and Platon, makes us feel that we can leave our puppy with a safe and good person who gives a peace of mind that all pet parents should get from every veterinarian. I highly recommend Ida for her good, knowledgeable advice, follow-up and the security she provides.
